description: "Rollo at Play; Or, Safe Amusements" by Jacob Abbott is a children's book likely written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This engaging tale is part of the Rollo Series, which follows a young boy named Rollo as he experiences various adventures and learns valuable life lessons through play and interactions with others.

authorInfo.bio: Jacob Abbott (1803–1879) wrote Rollo at Play; Or, Safe Amusements. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
